patch.summary: Getscreen.me implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Getscreen.me by mapping current project-management workflows to Getscreen.me objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Windows, Macos, Linux) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Windows

blocks.heading: Getscreen.me day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Getscreen.me setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for automations and workflows, docs and collaboration, reporting dashboards before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Support and IT teams needing remote desktop / screen share before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Windows and Macos before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Adjacent remote-access tool — not a project management platform
Do not expand seats until automations and workflows is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Adjacent remote-access tool — not a project management platform

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Hybrid user + device pricing means TCO rises with device count

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Free is capped at 1 user / 2 devices

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: No work OS boards, Gantt or PM reporting

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Getscreen.me plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

blocks.title: Validate project-management fit before a deep Getscreen.me rollout
blocks.body: If Getscreen.me fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on automations and workflows
If blocked, evaluate monday.com before sunk-cost expansion
